natural_input.description: Show a one-step recurrent filter computation with only X, Previous State, Scale Input, Scale State, Add, Next State. Scale Input computes a*x[t]; Scale State computes b*h[t-1]; both terms feed Add; Add produces Next State h[t]. Previous State and Next State are different logical versions. No feedback control, no hardware, no cycle schedule.
